display_name: The whole Goods and Services Tax Act 1993 under one top-level goal — is GST charged on this supply and how, when, at what rate, how much, and who accounts for it — and six goals: the charge, registration, input tax, assessment and appeal, collection and rulings, penalties
scope: Every provision of the Act as printed in SSO's informal consolidation of the version in force from 11 September 2026 (2020 Revised Edition). Inputs: the Comptroller's, Minister's and Board's discretions; regulations; the Fourth Schedule and s 21(3) classification; facts. Carried as text: the provisions listed in each module. NOT encoded: nothing in the Act.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-10 (tests-independent.l4, 243 assertions from expectations written before the encoding was read): it found the top-level reverse charge treated wrongly and smaller gaps (s 73A, deemed supplies, pre-2007 refunds, the ruling end date), all fixed; 242 now pass, and the 1 failure (E166) is the report's own leap-year slip, kept as an expected failure. The source is SSO's unofficial consolidation. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F2: s 39B without election: time-of-supply rules apply.
forks.F3: s 60(1)(b): 2% a month only after the 60 days, counted from the due date, cap 50%.
forks.F4: s 58: imprisonment in default recorded as a 6-month term, not an alternative.
forks.F6: Fifth Schedule para 6(b): a ruling's last day is the day before the third anniversary.
